main.description: The drive key, wrapped for one passkey. The first one's record key is 'first'.

credentialID.description: The passkey's WebAuthn credential ID, base64url.

keyID.description: Public ID of the drive key inside.

wrapped.description: The 32-byte drive key, AES-256-GCM ([format 0x01][nonce 12][ciphertext][tag 16]) under HKDF-SHA256(the passkey's PRF output for SHA-256("atdrive drive key v1\n" + DID), info "atdrive passkey wrap v1"), with '<space URI>/me.jsnelgro.atdrive.key/<credentialID>' as associated data.
